name: adrv9361-loopback-3slot
description: Short ADRV9361-Z7035 bring-up plan: three FastLock slots, six hops, one of each kind per round. Tones (tx_lo - rx_lo + f_dds) +1, +3, -2 MHz: 0->1 moves only TX (+1 -> +3 MHz), 1->2 only RX (+3 -> -2 MHz), 2->0 both (-2 -> +1 MHz). Same 1.25 s period, settle and capture as adrv9361-loopback-8slot.
